record.question: Which of the following medication will be prescribed for reducing high intracranial pressure?
record.explanation: Answer A: Osmotic diuretic. Mannitol is an osmotic diuretic used in selected cases to lower raised intracranial pressure. Source/context note: Use is clinically supervised and depends on hemodynamics and renal function. Reference: https://braintrauma.org/coma/guidelines/severe-tbi-4th-edition. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
